caption:
That however makes the comma feel safe. It isn't.

Two full sentences meet at the blank. The however sits inside sentence two, so it can't hold them together. Use a semicolon.

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.

youtube.title: Comma Splice Hiding Behind 'However' (SAT Trap)
youtube.description: A however inside the second clause can't join two sentences, so the comma is still a splice. SAT-style practice question (original).
